newsitem.title: USA: IES says two Iowa power units in start up.
newsitem.headline: IES says two Iowa power units in start up.

text.p: IES Utilities Inc said its Duane Arnold nuclear power unit and its Ottumwa coal-fired power unit in Iowa were in start up modes Wednesday and expected to be on line later in the day.
"We anticipate that both plants will be up and on line by late this evening," an IES spokesman said Wednesday.
The 675 megawatt (MW) Ottumwa plant, near the town of Ottumwa in southeastern Iowa, was shut Sunday to repair a boiler tube leak.
Ottumwa is about 48 percent owned and operated by IES, with MidAmerican Energy Co holding the remaining ownership.
The 538 MW Duane Arnold nuclear plant, located in Palo, Iowa, was taken off line Friday for maintenance.
IES is a subsidiary of IES Industries Inc.
